newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo posts record parent current profit in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo posts record parent current profit in 96/97.

text.p: Japanese pharmaceutical firm Sankyo Co said on Tuesday its parent current profit for the year ended on March 31 is expected to have risen 26 percent to a record 110 billion yen, topping 100 billion yen for the first time.
The boost in profit was mainly due to strong sales, including a new diabetes drug called Noscal.
The company said it will probably increase its annual dividend by 3.8 yen to 22.4 yen per share.
Sales were up seven percent to 440 billion yen in 1996/97.
For the current business year, it expects its parent current profit to rise five percent to 115 billion yen. It also sees sales rising two percent to 450 billion yen.
A Sankyo spokesman said it will officially announce its business results for 1996/97 and forecasts for 1997/98 on May 20.
